## Near-Shape And Variant Review / 近形与异体复核

No near-shape or variant judgment is made here. Reviewers should compare the
local image, glyph-codepoint clues, and independent component sources before
promoting any relationship.

此处不作近形或异体判断。复核者应先比较本地图像、glyph-codepoint 线索和独立构件来源，再决定是否提升关系。
